activity.notes: Gundahar is a historical Burgundian king underlying the later Gunther/Gunnar heroic tradition. He is securely attested as king by 412, but that year is a first-attestation anchor rather than a known accession date; his death and the destruction of the Rhine kingdom are dated 437 or 438. ATLAS therefore uses c.412-c.437 with both boundaries approximate.

sources.title: Gundahar
sources.citation_text: Deutsche Biographie identifies Gundahar as King of the Burgundians, attested in 412 and killed in 437 or 438, while distinguishing the historical core from later Nibelungen legend.
